subtitle_en: The Resolve to Establish Good Systems/Norms
description: RSP's 100 policy foundations for transformation, released as part of the vacha patra before the 2082 BS general election. Contains 5 priority areas and 100 detailed policy foundations. This is the primary document against which government performance is scored.

preamble.commitment_np: तपाईंहरूले हामीलाई एकल बहुमत दिलाएको अवस्थामा पनि करार बमोजिमका सर्तहरू डेलिभरी सहित ५ वर्षभित्र बुझाउन नसकी तपाईं नागरिकलाई मर्का पर्न गएमा, संविधान, मौजुदा कानुन र सामाजिक करार अनुसार हाम्रो 'राजनैतिक नैतिकता' र पद' बाट अर्को पटकको निर्वाचनमा सजाय दिई असुल उपर गरी लिनु होला।
preamble.commitment_en: If, even after you grant us a single-party majority, we fail to deliver the terms of this agreement within five years and cause you citizens hardship, you may punish us according to the constitution, existing laws, and social contract by holding us accountable in the next election.

priority_areas.goal_en: Anti-Corruption Mega-Campaign. Universal digital delivery of government services. Massive improvement in corruption indices. End politicization. Investigate agreements since 2076 BS.
Nepal as middle-income country. 7% GDP growth. Per capita $3,000+. Economy $100B within 5-7 years. 100% insured health. Public education reform. Integrated social security. End usurious lending.
Create 500,000 new formal, dignified, safe, inclusive jobs. Priority: IT, construction, tourism, agriculture, minerals, industry, service trade.
Quality road and air networks. Reliable energy grid. High-speed internet to all settlements. 15,000 MW installed. 30,000 km highways. 10 signature projects.
Online voting for Nepalis abroad. Citizenship continuity. Sovereign diaspora fund. Safe investment and dignified return. Decent foreign employment.

goals_2087.note: Goals for BS 2087 (2030-31 CE) — 5-year targets if RSP runs majority government

items.summary_en: End requirement to visit offices. Faceless, paperless administration. Citizen App + NID integrated. Past corruption cases finalized. 100% meritocracy in constitutional bodies.
Shift to production/export economy. 5,000 MW domestic consumption. 50% reduction in LPG imports. Nepal Production Fund + Remittance Investment Fund. 20% reduction in forced foreign migration.

items.title_en: Equitable Society and Integrated Social Security
items.summary_en: State presence from womb to cremation. Contribution-based social security to informal sector. Universal design infrastructure. Reduce personal health expenditure via insurance.

items.title_en: IT Hub and Skilled Human Capital
items.summary_en: Nepal as reliable IT export destination. Every Class 12 graduate gets vocational skill certificate. Mega-skill centers in 7 provinces. IT exports over Rs 50 billion/year.

items.title_en: Clean Cities and Climate Diplomacy Leadership
items.summary_en: 50% reduction in air pollution in major cities. Complete Chure exploitation control. Prevent Madhesh desertification. Nepal as climate diplomacy leader.
Reform procurement. Modern blue buses and electric transport in Kathmandu, Pokhara, Biratnagar. Scientific route permits. End transport syndicate. ITS deployment.

items.title_en: Modern Drinking Water, Sanitation, Environmental Justice
items.summary_en: 24-hour clean water to every home via smart distribution. Waste-to-Wealth model. River rejuvenation. Disability-friendly sanitation.
15,000 MW installed. Smart grid. Energy export center. 30,000 km highways. 10 signature projects. High-speed internet everywhere. Economic corridors.
